study/hypothesis: ln(share poor) rises linearly with age over the first 45 years (doubling time near 7 years); at 40–59 years steel bridges rate lower than prestressed concrete ones.
study/name: Does the poor share grow exponentially with a bridge's age?
study/question: Across the 2025 National Bridge Inventory, does the share of bridges in poor condition grow exponentially with age (a constant doubling time), and does the main-span material matter once age is held fixed?
